# Indigo

> A fork of Swiss for the Nintendo GameCube with the interface rebuilt: an animated glass Home cube, a box-art and cover-art library in four layouts, per-game details and Gecko cheat toggles, a visual Memory Cards manager (physical cards, SD folders and Swiss `.raw` virtual cards) and a two-pane File Browser, drawn in the console's own visual language.

Indigo (`cube/swiss/source/gui/`, GPL-2.0-or-later, C with devkitPPC and libogc2) replaces the user interface of upstream [Swiss](https://github.com/emukidid/swiss-gc) while keeping upstream's device handlers, patch engine, game loader, `.raw` virtual memory card emulation, MemCard PRO GC game-ID switching and in-game reset (`A + Z + START` with `swiss/patches/apploader.img`). Settings in `swiss/swiss.ini` and `swiss/settings/*.ini` are shared in both directions with upstream Swiss.

Runs on any Nintendo GameCube that already runs Swiss and reads an SD card (SD2SP2, SD Gecko or the loader's own slot), or a Wii with GameCube ports running Swiss in GameCube mode with an SD Gecko. GC Loader (`/boot.dol` beside a Swiss `boot.iso`), PicoBoot/PicoLoader (`/ipl.dol`) and FlippyDrive (`/boot.dol`) can start Indigo at power-on; every setup can also open `/apps/indigo.dol` from Swiss. Read these first: [docs/guide/install.md](docs/guide/install.md) to set up an SD card, [docs/guide/README.md](docs/guide/README.md) for every screen and setting, and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for architecture, build and test commands.

## Docs

- [Install guide](docs/guide/install.md): four-step SD card setup and full card layout for GC Loader, PicoBoot, PicoLoader, FlippyDrive, SD2SP2 and SD Gecko (at power-on or from Swiss), plus updating and returning to stock Swiss.
- [Guide overview](docs/guide/README.md): index of every user-facing screen and setting in Indigo.
- [Controls](docs/guide/controls.md): controller buttons across every screen and `A + Z + START` in-game reset back to Indigo.
- [Source](docs/guide/source.md): choosing the storage device Indigo reads games from (SD2SP2, SD Gecko, GC Loader, FlippyDrive, DVD drive, Memory Card Adapter or network).
- [Library](docs/guide/library.md): browsing games in `/games` (or `Library Path`) as box art in Horizontal, Vertical, Grid or Gameplay Spotlight layouts, in one list or two levels of folders.
- [Home](docs/guide/home.md): the animated glass Home cube, Classic vs Infinite cube modes, Sway idle animation, and choosing which menu sits on Up, Left, Right and Down faces.
- [Game details](docs/guide/game-details.md): per-game screen with cover art, save file and copy counts, per-game settings, Gecko cheats and the animated launch ring.
- [Cheats](docs/guide/cheats.md): enabling WiiRD and Gecko cheat codes from `/swiss/cheats/<ID>.txt` per game, with codes that would break Indigo filtered and marked.
- [Settings](docs/guide/settings.md): Quick settings, Defaults for every game, and Setup (Console, Appearance, Library, Storage, Network, Advanced).
- [Make it yours](docs/guide/personalize.md): eight menu colors, sixteen cube face icons, background wave colors and speeds, and 32 kHz menu music.
- [System](docs/guide/system.md): console hardware information, Memory Cards, the two-pane File Browser (copy, move, rename, hide and delete across devices) and restarting Indigo.
- [Memory Cards](docs/guide/memory-cards.md): inspecting, copying, moving and erasing GameCube saves across Slot A, Slot B, SD folders and Swiss `.raw` virtual memory card images with read-back verification.
- [Posters](docs/guide/posters.md): using the all-region box-art and Spotlight pack (`/swiss/ui/posters.pak` for 1,622 games) or building a custom pack with `buildtools/posters/build_poster_pack.py`.
- [Apps](docs/guide/apps.md): launching GameCube homebrew (`.dol`, `.cli`, `.dcp`) from `/apps` (and `/emulators`) with custom PNG posters converted on the console.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/guide/troubleshooting.md): fixing missing `/games` libraries, SD card formatting, video mode recovery, MemCard PRO GC and returning to stock Swiss.
- [Settings files](docs/SETTINGS.md): reference for `swiss/swiss.ini` and `swiss/settings/<game>.ini` keys.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history and user-visible changes.

## Development and releases

- [Agent and contributor guide](AGENTS.md): repository layout, upstream boundary (`UPSTREAM`), Docker build command, host test lanes (`buildtools/ui/tests/run_tests.sh all`), Dolphin emulator route tests and libFuzzer targets.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to propose changes, branch workflow (`beta` for development, `main` for releases) and DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [Releasing](docs/RELEASING.md): beta, release candidate and stable release procedures, reproducible build checks and MemCard PRO hardware qualification gates.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md) and [NOTICE](NOTICE): private vulnerability reporting, GPL-2.0-or-later licensing, upstream Swiss provenance and third-party credits.
- [Web guide and downloads](https://norvitech.com/indigo/): interactive install chooser, video tour, all-region poster and cheat packs, and `https://norvitech.com/indigo/llms.txt`.
